result.summary: Delvaux Commodities SA shows a worsening payment pattern: settled invoices moved from on-time/4 days late to 9 days late, and the current open invoice INV002183 (€173,322) is now 12 days past due. Two further invoices totaling ~€357,744 are not yet due, keeping exposure well within the €1.46M single-insurer credit limit, but the lengthening delay trend warrants closer monitoring.
concerns: Days-late on settled invoices has trended upward (0→4→9 days) and the newest open invoice is already 12 days overdue, indicating a deteriorating payment pattern.
Limited history (only 3 settled invoices) means the trend read should be confirmed with more data points.
Aggregate open exposure (~€531k) is modest relative to the €1.46M credit limit, but continued slippage could erode this buffer if late payments compound.
